name: 7-methyltryptamine
summary: 7-Methyltryptamine (7-Me-T or 7-methyl-T; developmental code name PAL-286) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. It is the 7-methyl derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 7-Methyltryptamine (7-Me-T or 7-methyl-T; developmental code name PAL-286) is a serotonin receptor modulator and monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine family. The drug acts as a potent full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 44.7 nM and an Emax of 103%. It shows 6-fold lower potency as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist compared to tryptamine itself.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors and serotonin release.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體與血清素釋放的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体与血清素释放的实验室研究。

fact.en: Its code name PAL-286 places it in a numbered series of tryptamines made to compare how methyl groups at different ring positions change what the drug releases.
fact.zh: 它的代號PAL-286顯示它屬於一個編號的色胺系列，製作目的是比較甲基接在環的不同位置時，藥物釋放的物質會如何改變。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号PAL-286显示它属于一个编号的色胺系列，制作目的是比较甲基接在环的不同位置时，药物释放的物质会如何改变。
